bio: Mladen Trampic is a Senior Technical Account Manager for AWS Enterprise Support EMEA in Vienna, where he helps customers architect for reliability and cost efficiency. Before AWS he was a Data Lake Solution Architect at Raiffeisen Bank International. He has co-authored AWS blog posts on Session Manager logging guardrails in a multi-account environment and on how Flo Health optimized Amazon DynamoDB, and he writes about Kiro CLI, MCP and AI-assisted development on his blog.
